text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images, or making decisions. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it when we ask voice assistants questions, when streaming services recommend films, and when our phones recognise our faces to unlock. AI is also used in hospitals, banks, and transport systems, making our lives easier and faster.
